name: Draft a reminder about an obligation
description: Drafts an email reminding the members who hold a role, such as the company secretary or the accountant, about an obligation: a filing, a deadline or a step the company must take. It is sent only after a person approves it, once, to the members of that role with a sign-in email, and ends by saying the AI drafted it and a person approved it. It files, approves or marks nothing as met.

to_role.description: The role whose members it reminds.

subject.description: The email's subject, in plain words.

message.description: The reminder: what is due, by when, why, and what to do next, in plain words with no figures you did not read.

obligation.description: The finding or statutory calendar item it concerns, by its key, such as calendar:annual_return:2027-07-31.
